goal: length, angle, count and ratio typed parameter values
positive_oracle: Value giữ đúng chiều; đọc lại bằng as_length/as_angle/as_count/as_ratio.
negative_oracle: Số trần không phải length/angle; count 2.5 là NotAnInteger; sai chiều là WrongDimension.
decision_note: Legacy `command_options.rs` carries dimensioned option values through C; OM9 keeps the typed value in Rust and reads it back typed.
method: Read the legacy `rust/` module named above and the target crate; the portable behaviour is re-implemented in safe Rust (AGENTS.md rust-first) without the legacy C ABI. No legacy code is copied verbatim.
